title: Your colleague has a new phone
scenario: A colleague messages from their normal account saying they replaced their phone and cannot access MFA. They ask you to approve a device-registration request because “IT said a teammate can vouch for me.”

answers.A: Do not approve; direct them to the official identity-recovery/help-desk process.
answers.B: Call the colleague on a known number and help them contact IT without approving any security request yourself.
answers.C: Approve because you personally know the colleague and can confirm they really got a new phone.

explanation: Knowing the person does not authorize bypassing identity controls, and their account may be compromised.
proTip: Friendship is not an MFA recovery method.
